title: Hello? I'm Under the Water
blurb: An emergency described in the tone of somebody ordering a sandwich. The clip became legendary purely on that mismatch — the words report a genuine crisis and the voice reports an unremarkable Tuesday, with no attempt made to reconcile the two. It is the perfect sound for situations handled with inexplicable calm: a deadline arriving, a flat flooding, life proceeding entirely without your input. Play it when somebody asks how the project is going and the honest answer is not encouraging. Too much rain. Please help me.
origin: From a viral clip of the world's calmest drowning report.
